text.tspan: Rejected: a box in every home, language model included

svg.text: A Raspberry Pi 5 with AI HAT+ (€200) or a Jetson Orin Nano Super (€269): €6.55 to €8.64 per home a month,
and €107.5 M to €142.0 M of hardware for 500,000 homes (document 17).
The language model needs more memory again (about 1 GB for the prototype’s, 2.1 GB for the 4B one tried,
three times slower), and every update has to reach 500,000 boxes.

text.tspan: Rejected: video or full frames to the cloud

svg.text: A continuous stream at 2 Mbps (assumption): 657 GB per camera a month and 1,000 Gbps at the peak with
500,000 cameras. Full frames during motion: €2.41 per home a month on Altice’s servers and €3.93 to €4.26
The whole picture of the home would leave it.
